{"name": "run_python", "parameters": {"code": "import csv
catalog = list(csv.DictReader(open('CATALOG_CSV')))
values = list(csv.DictReader(open('VALUES_CSV')))
p = next(p for p in catalog if p['point_class'] == 'whole-building electricity use' and p['quantity_kind'] == 'hourly')
t = p['timeseries_id']
electricity_use = [int(v['value']) for v in values if v['timeseries_id'] == t and v['timestamp'].startswith('2018-01')]
highest_usage = max(electricity_use)
print(highest_usage)"}}
